notes: Posted objective 'My Kind Of Stormtroopers/Who cares you don't flip' is a joke name for My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive: the description says 'Uses a MKOS start' and the deck starts Tatooine: Desert Heart and Jabba's Palace: Lower Passages (both marked '(s)').

Starting cards: the objective, Tatooine: Desert Heart, Jabba's Palace: Lower Passages, Prepared Defenses (posted 'Perepared Defenses'), and the Effects marked 'always S': Well Guarded and There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement (posted 'TINT/Oppresive Enforcement'); they count. The strategy picks the other starting Effects by matchup (Imperial Decree, You Cannot Hide Forever, Secret Plans), so no single starting Effect is set.

Posted 'Mosep (rep)' dested Mosep; 'Trooper Davin Felth (Filthy Dave)' dested Trooper Davin Felth (A New Hope), not the virtual card; 'Well Guarded (always S)' dested Well Guarded (Jabba's Palace), not the virtual card; 'Darth Vader' = Darth Vader (Premiere); 'Maras saber' = Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Twilek Advisor' = Twi'lek Advisor.
Secret Plans counted as an Effect (2001, Special Edition).
Total as published: 60 (the Interrupts header says 19 but 20 are listed).
The same list was later published on Game Players Network (7 December 2001) by 'Bravo 3' and is on the wiki as [[Bravo 3 Filthy Daves Trooper Takedown]].
